info.name: FEKRA — Sign-up & Content Journeys
info.description:
End-to-end API tests for the FEKRA website.

**There is no public user registration in this project.** `users` is admin-only (`create: isAdmin`) and the agreed scope has no visitor accounts. The sign-up surface that does exist is covered here:

1. Newsletter signup
2. Contact enquiry
3. Careers application (with CV upload)
4. CMS authentication
5. Content publish lifecycle

Leave ~60s between full runs — the rate limiters are per-IP and per-minute.

Run the folders **in order** — the rate-limit assertions depend on how many requests preceded them, and the content folder threads an id between requests.

Setup:
- Import `FEKRA.local.postman_environment.json`
- `pnpm dev` and `pnpm seed` must have run
- Postman → Settings → **disable** 'Automatically follow redirects'
- Re-attach the two files in the Careers folder if Postman drops the relative paths

item.name: 7 · Rate limiting
item.description:
Runs LAST on purpose. These probes deliberately exhaust the per-IP budget, so anything scheduled after them would get spurious 429s.

The limiters are 5/60s for contact and newsletter, 3/60s for apply. Leave ~60 seconds between full collection runs, or the functional folders will start with an empty budget and fail.

request.description: ponytail: the limiter is an in-process Map, so on serverless the real ceiling is limit x instances. Enough to stop a naive script; swap in Redis if a distributed limit is ever needed.
